s3.title: Preview object storage
s3.local_hint: Local by default. When enabled, both list thumbnails and reader previews are saved to the selected object storage provider.
s3.mode_direct: Public URLs: previews load directly from the bucket or configured public domain.
s3.mode_proxy: Both preview profiles are stored in S3 and proxied after site permission checks.
s3.mode_signed: Private R2: site permission checks followed by a redirect to a signed URL valid for 5 minutes.
s3.enable: Use object storage for newly generated previews
s3.endpoint_hint_s3: Enter the S3-compatible API endpoint supplied by your storage provider.
s3.r2_settings: R2 uses region auto and path-style addressing automatically.
s3.cdn_url: Public / CDN base URL (optional, including https://)
s3.public_warning: Public preview URLs bypass OpenList login, directory passwords and share revocation. Your bucket or configured public domain must allow public reads. These links are not short-lived signed URLs. Do not use for confidential previews.
s3.tested: Write, read and deletion verified. Ready to save.
s3.failed: Storage operation failed. Check your settings.
s3.bytes: Object storage bytes from this system

console.heading: Preview task center
console.subtitle: Manage generation, automatic rules and local preview storage.
console.delete_history_hint: Delete only the selected task history and item records. Published previews and originals are retained. Active tasks cannot be deleted.
console.rescan_hint: Scan the same directory again, creating or reusing a task. Valid previews are reused; only new, missing or changed files are generated.
console.action_pause: Stop claiming new work after the current bounded file finishes.
console.action_resume: Resume remaining work in this task.
console.action_retry: Retry failed, partial or cancelled items only. Successful profiles are retained.
console.action_cancel: Cancel remaining work without deleting previews or originals.
console.action_rescan: Discover new or changed files in the directory.
console.progress_hint: Share of processed files, not a success rate. Skipped and failed files are included.
console.batch_hint: Only selected eligible tasks on this page are affected. Counts show the actual action scope.
console.empty_hint: Choose a directory to generate previews in the background, or create a task from the file browser.
console.choose_task_hint: Inspect scope, progress and file results, or create a generation task.
console.detail_failed: Could not load details. Refresh to retry.
console.enable_rule_hint: Enabling schedules preview generation within this directory. Other mounts and original files are not modified.
console.stale_hint: Previous results are retained and may be outdated.
console.s3_disk_hint: S3 ignores the local 5 GiB reserve. Generation pauses only if temporary download or encoding space is insufficient.
console.cleanup_temporary_hint: Local generation leftovers, unused and older than 24 hours.
console.verify_hint: Run manually when previews have problems; upgrades and restarts do not trigger full verification. Checks all ready previews: local paths, sizes and SHA256; for S3/R2, only local metadata and object keys are checked, without accessing buckets or verifying remote object contents. Confirmed invalid records are marked missing. No files are deleted and no images are regenerated.
console.verify_running: Verifying existing previews. This may take a while (up to a 10-minute request timeout)…
console.verify_failed: Verification did not complete: the request failed or timed out. Please retry later. Some records may already have been marked missing.
console.verify_cancelled: Verification cancelled before the full check completed. Records already marked missing are unchanged.
console.cleanup_detection_hint: Successful replacement and site file operations mark old previews automatically. External changes require a directory rescan; automatic rules can schedule scans. Offline sources and failed scans do not confirm deletion.

reasons.s3_object_missing: The preview object is missing. Regenerate the affected items.
reasons.s3_checksum_mismatch: Preview content verification failed. Regenerate the affected items.
reasons.s3_cdn_probe_failed: Cannot read the uploaded test object through the CDN domain. Verify its bucket binding and public access.
reasons.skipped_limit: Image exceeds the processing safety limit.
reasons.unsupported_format: This format is not supported; use the original.
reasons.unsupported_animation: Animated images are skipped; use the original.
reasons.long_image_requires_original: This long image requires the original for readable detail.
reasons.invalid_image: The source image is invalid or damaged.
reasons.derivative_disk_protection: Processing is paused to protect local disk space.
reasons.storage_binding_changed: The storage binding changed; verify the directory scope.
reasons.creator_not_active_admin: The task creator no longer has active administrator access.
reasons.source_not_found: The original file was not found.
reasons.source_network_error: The source storage could not be reached.
reasons.source_http_429: The source storage is rate limiting requests.
reasons.derivative_operation_failed: The operation failed; inspect the task details.
reasons.rule_deleted: The rule was deleted; unfinished jobs were paused.

title: Preview images
force_hint: Valid outputs remain available until replacements are published. Original files are not changed.
generate_hint: The job runs in the background. Valid results are reused by default; the task center opens after submission.
scope_hint: Only this directory scope is processed. Crossing mounts, aliases or referenced storage is not supported; create separate rules for those locations.
refresh_failed: Some preview statuses could not be refreshed. Check access and try again.
request_failed: Could not load preview data. Polling retries with backoff; you can also refresh.
action_failed: The action failed. Refresh the task state and check access, scope and server health before retrying.
jobs_hint: Start a job from a directory’s “Generate previews” action. Scanning and encoding run in the background.
scan_complete: Directory scan complete. File processing may still be running.
scan_discovered: Discovered so far — scanning is incomplete or some directories failed. These are not final totals.
cancel_confirm: Cancel this job’s remaining work? Successfully published previews and original files will be kept.
job_actions_hint: Pause stops new work after the current bounded file. Cancel keeps published results; retry only fills failed or cancelled work.
rules_hint: Rules are off by default. Enable only after confirming the directory and exclusions. Periodic scans discover new or changed files.
rule_pause_hint: Pausing a rule stops new automatic jobs only. Existing jobs continue; pause them separately in Jobs.
name: Name
invalid_interval: Enter a scan interval between 0.25 and 8760 hours.
delete_rule_confirm: Delete this rule? Its unfinished jobs will be paused. Existing previews and original files will not be deleted.
invalid_path: Use an explicit absolute directory without traversal, duplicate separators or special routes.
encoder_warning: Disabling this feature returns to originals and retains files. If only the encoder is unavailable, existing previews remain readable.
space_warning: Storage is near its safety limit. Generation may be paused; check the budget and available disk space.
cleanup_temporary_confirm: Remove local temporary files older than 24 hours and not used by running tasks? Originals and generated previews are retained.
cleanup_stale_confirm: Remove replaced or confirmed invalid old previews locally and in S3? Valid previews and originals are retained. Offline sources and failed scans are not grounds for deletion.
quality_hint: Switches only the pages needed for reading; originals are not prefetched for the whole book.
missing_preview: Some pages have no reading preview and will load the original when needed.
access_denied: Preview access could not be verified. Refresh access before retrying; no original fallback was attempted.
image_failed: Image failed to load. Retry this page.
